title: Mafaldine with Snow Peas, Cherry Tomatoes, Kale and Ricotta
subtitle: with pine nuts and lemon
description: Long pasta tossed with roasted cherry tomatoes, crispy kale, pine nuts, lemon and snow peas, finished with grated dry ricotta salata.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Roast the cherry tomatoes with 2 tbsp olive oil and coarse salt for about 10 minutes.

Heat 4 tbsp olive oil in a frying pan, add the finely chopped kale and fry for a few seconds until crispy. Add the roasted tomatoes, a handful of toasted pine nuts and the lemon juice, stir and remove from the heat.
Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions. In the last minute of cooking add 4 handfuls of sliced snow peas, then drain.
Transfer the pasta and snow peas to the pan with the sauce, add a handful of basil, 2 tbsp olive oil and salt, toss, and grate the ricotta salata over the top. Serve immediately.
